custom_fixtures.split_rule: By scenario index within each family (even = dev, odd = held-out); paraphrases never cross splits.

not_included.reason: Needs recorded audio from consenting speakers; covered today by manual-fallback unit tests (no_speech, multiple_speakers) and not scored here.
Run as Playwright scenarios with a stubbed model, and as live rehearsals; not scored in this text harness.

baselines.B0: Original input as the message, no model.
baselines.B1: One Gemini compose prompt; no phrasebook, no meaning check, no clarification loop.
baselines.B2: Production LangGraph workflow: phrasebook retrieval, compose, meaning check (model + deterministic critical slots), up to two clarification rounds.

judging: Automatic checks only (critical-token survival, negation, forbidden content, invented numbers/times, clarification behaviour). No LLM judges its own fidelity. Two-reviewer human labels on held-out cases are pending.
